Points to note:

1. Quarters unavailable for download: 1997Q4
2. 2002Q3 and 2002Q4 has fewer than normal CUSIPS which can affect downstream extraction

# 1. Load Package

```{python}
import io
import re
import sqlite3
import time
from pathlib import Path

import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import pandas as pd
import requests

from py.config import cfg
from py.utils_dates import make_quarter_tbl
from py.utils_db import sqlite_path

# Optional PDF/OCR dependency note:
# This notebook expects pdfplumber (text extraction) and pytesseract+pdf2image (OCR) for pre-2004.

```

# 2. Setup

```{python}
dates = make_quarter_tbl(
    start_year=1996,
    end_year=cfg.end_year,
)

qa_dir_01b = cfg.qa_dir / "01b"
qa_dir_01b.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
```

# 3. Create SEC list pdf urls

```{python}
input_df = dates.copy()


def build_link(row: pd.Series) -> str:
    year = int(row["year"])
    qtr = int(row["qtr"])

    if year == 2004 and qtr == 1:
        return "https://www.sec.gov/divisions/investment/13f-list.pdf"

    if year < 2021:
        return f"https://www.sec.gov/divisions/investment/13f/13flist{year}q{qtr}.pdf"

    if year == 2021 and qtr <= 2:
        return f"https://www.sec.gov/divisions/investment/13f/13flist{year}q{qtr}.pdf"

    return f"https://www.sec.gov/files/investment/13flist{year}q{qtr}.pdf"


input_df["link"] = input_df.apply(build_link, axis=1)
```

# 4. Functions

## 4.1 Parse one page of the pdf into a table

```{python}
def parse_one_page(page_lines: list[str], mode: str = "post") -> pd.DataFrame | None:
    if not any("CUSIP NO" in line for line in page_lines):
        return None

    start_idx = next(i for i, line in enumerate(page_lines) if "CUSIP NO" in line)
    page = page_lines[start_idx:]

    if mode == "post":
        header = page[0]

        issuer_name_pos = header.find("ISSUER NAME")
        issuer_desc_pos = header.find("ISSUER DESCRIPTION")
        status_pos = header.find("STATUS")

        if min(issuer_name_pos, issuer_desc_pos, status_pos) < 0:
            return None

        max_len = max(len(x) for x in page)
        seps = [0, issuer_name_pos, issuer_desc_pos, status_pos, max_len]

        rows = []
        for row in page:
            padded = row.ljust(max_len)
            split = [padded[seps[i] : seps[i + 1]].strip() for i in range(len(seps) - 1)]
            rows.append(split)

        df = pd.DataFrame(rows, columns=["cusip", "issuer_name", "issuer_description", "status"])

    else:
        max_len = max(len(x) for x in page)
        rows = []
        for row in page:
            padded = row.ljust(max_len)
            rows.append([padded[0:10].strip(), padded[10:max_len].strip()])

        df = pd.DataFrame(rows, columns=["cusipno", "other"])

    if len(df) <= 2:
        return None

    return df.iloc[1:].reset_index(drop=True)
```

## 4.2 Download individual pdfs and parse all pages

```{python}
def pdf_text_pages(tmp_pdf: Path, pre2004: bool) -> list[str]:
    if pre2004:
        images = convert_from_path(tmp_pdf)
        return [pytesseract.image_to_string(img) for img in images]

    pages = []
    with pdfplumber.open(tmp_pdf) as pdf:
        for page in pdf.pages:
            pages.append(page.extract_text() or "")
    return pages


def download_sec_list(link: str, year: int) -> pd.DataFrame:
    pre2004 = year < 2004
    mode = "pre" if pre2004 else "post"

    tmp_pdf = cfg.staging_dir / "tmp_cusip.pdf"
    cfg.staging_dir.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)

    ok = False
    for attempt in range(1, 4):
        print(f"Attempt {attempt}/3 for {Path(link).name}")
        try:
            response = requests.get(
                link,
                headers={"User-Agent": cfg.sec_user_agent},
                timeout=cfg.timeout_sec,
            )
            response.raise_for_status()
            tmp_pdf.write_bytes(response.content)
            ok = True
            break
        except requests.RequestException:
            print("Download failed, waiting 30s before retry")
            time.sleep(30)

    if not ok:
        if tmp_pdf.exists():
            tmp_pdf.unlink()
        raise RuntimeError(f"Failed to download PDF after 3 attempts {link}")

    page_text = pdf_text_pages(tmp_pdf, pre2004=pre2004)
    page_tables = []
    for page in page_text:
        tbl = parse_one_page(page.split("\n"), mode=mode)
        if tbl is not None:
            page_tables.append(tbl)

    if tmp_pdf.exists():
        tmp_pdf.unlink()

    if len(page_tables) == 0:
        return pd.DataFrame()

    return pd.concat(page_tables, ignore_index=True)
```

## 4.3 Clean table

```{python}
def clean_cusip_list_post(cusip_df: pd.DataFrame) -> pd.DataFrame:
    out = cusip_df.copy()
    out = out.loc[out["cusip"].notna()].copy()
    out["asterisk"] = out["cusip"].str.contains(r"\*", na=False)
    out["cusip"] = out["cusip"].str.replace(r"\s|\*", "", regex=True)
    out["nchar"] = out["cusip"].str.len()
    out = out.loc[out["nchar"] == 9].drop_duplicates(subset=["cusip"]).reset_index(drop=True)
    return out


def checksum_check(cusips: list[str], return_check: bool = True) -> list[bool] | list[int]:
    def checksum_value(ch: str, pos: int) -> int:
        if ch.isdigit():
            x = int(ch)
        elif ch.isalpha():
            x = ord(ch.upper()) - ord("A") + 10
        else:
            return 0

        if pos % 2 == 0:
            x = 2 * x

        return x // 10 + x % 10

    checks = []
    values = []

    for c in cusips:
        c = re.sub(r"\s", "", c)
        chars = list(c)

        if len(chars) < 9:
            values.append(0)
            checks.append(False)
            continue

        total = 0
        for pos in range(1, 9):
            total += checksum_value(chars[pos - 1], pos)

        implied = (10 - (total % 10)) % 10
        values.append(implied)
        checks.append(chars[8] == str(implied))

    return checks if return_check else values


def clean_cusip_list_pre(cusip_df: pd.DataFrame) -> pd.DataFrame:
    table = cusip_df.copy()

    table = table.loc[
        table["cusipno"].notna()
        & table["other"].notna()
        & (table["cusipno"] != "")
        & (table["other"] != "")
    ].copy()

    table = table.loc[~table["cusipno"].str.contains("total", case=False, na=False)].copy()

    cusips = table["cusipno"].str.strip().str.upper().tolist()
    others = table["other"].str.strip().tolist()

    issues = [
        r"4%", r"%", r"\.", r"^\|", r"\|", r"8\&$", r"\&", r"J/", r"/ ", r"/",
        r"\)", r"G@|4@|@", r" 1\] ", r"1\]|\]j|\]", r"¥Y|¥", r"§", r"\?", r"\$", r"}$", r"}",
    ]
    replace = ["", "4", "", "", "1", "", "8", "J", "J", "", "J", "4", "11", "1", "Y", "4", "7", "3", "1", ""]
    errors = [r";", r"'", r"\+", r"°", r"=", r",", r"\(", r"~", r"¢", r"\_", r"\:", r"\#", r"\.", r"-", r"—"]

    for e in errors:
        cusips = [re.sub(e, "", c) for c in cusips]

    check = checksum_check(cusips, return_check=True)

    for issue, rep in zip(issues, replace):
        bad_idx = [i for i, ok in enumerate(check) if ok is not True]

        c1 = [re.sub(issue, rep, cusips[i]).strip() for i in bad_idx]
        c2 = [re.sub(r"[^A-Za-z0-9\s]", "", cusips[i]).strip() for i in bad_idx]

        c1_check = checksum_check(c1, return_check=True)
        c2_check = checksum_check(c2, return_check=True)

        combined = c1[:]
        combined_check = c1_check[:]

        for j in range(len(c2)):
            if c2_check[j] is True:
                combined[j] = c2[j]
                combined_check[j] = c2_check[j]

        for k, idx in enumerate(bad_idx):
            cusips[idx] = combined[k]
            check[idx] = combined_check[k]

    cusips = [re.sub(r"[^A-Za-z0-9]", "", c) for c in cusips]

    fixed = []
    for c, o in zip(cusips, others):
        if len(c) < 9:
            suffix = re.sub(r"[^A-Za-z0-9]", "", o)[: 9 - len(c)]
            c = c + suffix
        elif len(c) > 9:
            c = c[:9]
        fixed.append(c)

    out = pd.DataFrame({"cusipno": fixed})
    out = out.loc[out["cusipno"].str.contains(r"[0-9]", na=False)].copy()
    out["check"] = checksum_check(out["cusipno"].tolist(), return_check=True)
    out = out.drop_duplicates(subset=["cusipno"]).reset_index(drop=True)

    return out
```

# 5. Loop over all quarters in input

```{python}
for i, row in input_df.iterrows():
    this_link = row["link"]
    this_yrqtr = row["year_qtr"]
    this_yr = int(row["year"])
    pre2004 = this_yr < 2004

    sqlite_file = sqlite_path(this_yrqtr)

    print(f"Processing {i + 1} of {len(input_df)} year_qtr = {this_yrqtr}")

    start_time = time.time()

    try:
        cusip_df = download_sec_list(this_link, this_yr)
    except Exception:
        print(f"  → FAILED, skipping {this_yrqtr}\n")
        continue

    con = sqlite3.connect(sqlite_file)

    if pre2004:
        clean_cusip = clean_cusip_list_pre(cusip_df)
    else:
        clean_cusip = clean_cusip_list_post(cusip_df)

    print(f"  → {len(clean_cusip)} unique 13F CUSIPs\n")

    clean_cusip.to_sql("cusip_list", con, if_exists="replace", index=False)
    con.close()

    elapsed = time.time() - start_time
    print(f"Total time for {this_yrqtr}: {elapsed / 60:.1f} minutes ({elapsed:.1f} seconds)")
```

# 6. Output Summary

```{python}
cusip_summary = pd.DataFrame(
    {
        "year_qtr": dates["year_qtr"],
        "n_cusip": pd.NA,
    }
)

for i, yq in enumerate(dates["year_qtr"].tolist()):
    print(f"\n=== Quarter {i + 1}/{len(dates)}: {yq} ===")

    sqlite_file = sqlite_path(yq)

    if not sqlite_file.exists():
        print(f"No SQLite file for {yq}; skipping")
        continue

    con = sqlite3.connect(sqlite_file)
    try:
        has_table = con.execute(
            "SELECT name FROM sqlite_master WHERE type='table' AND name='cusip_list'"
        ).fetchone()

        if has_table is None:
            print(f"No cusip_list table for {yq}; skipping")
            continue

        n_rows = con.execute("SELECT COUNT(*) FROM cusip_list").fetchone()[0]
        cusip_summary.loc[i, "n_cusip"] = n_rows
    finally:
        con.close()

cusip_summary["year"] = cusip_summary["year_qtr"].str[:4].astype(int)
cusip_summary["qtr"] = cusip_summary["year_qtr"].str[4].astype(int)
cusip_summary = cusip_summary.sort_values(["year", "qtr"]).reset_index(drop=True)

x = cusip_summary["year"] + (cusip_summary["qtr"] - 1) / 4
y = pd.to_numeric(cusip_summary["n_cusip"], errors="coerce")

plt.figure(figsize=(8, 4))
plt.plot(x, y, color="steelblue")
plt.scatter(x, y, s=8, color="steelblue")
plt.title("Number of CUSIPs by Quarter")
plt.xlabel("Year")
plt.ylabel("Number of CUSIPs")
plt.tight_layout()
plt.savefig(qa_dir_01b / "cusip_summary.png", dpi=300)
plt.close()
```
